Q_reservoir_setup.lambda_shift: lambda^2+1=2*Q^2/M^2, hence v_q(lambda^2+1)=2h and the normalized unit has quadratic character Legendre(2,q)
Q_reservoir_setup.mu_character: the BU square normalization Tminus^2=(4*D0*rho/kappa)/mu and Legendre(D0,q)=+1 give Legendre(mu,q)=Legendre(kappa*rho,q)

character_coordinates.y: (B/A)*t^2, where t=v/u on the retained open
character_coordinates.d: Legendre(A*B,q), equivalently the normalized q-unit character of y because v_q(y) is even

four_root_model.meaning: these are exactly the four BT square-root equations after removing rational square factors at q

valuation_sector_taxonomy.small_y: v_q(y)>0 is realizable iff k=r=d=+1; then choose y with positive even valuation and all four parenthesized factors are 1 modulo q
valuation_sector_taxonomy.large_y: v_q(y)<0 likewise forces and is realizable for k=r=d=+1 after extracting the common even valuation
valuation_sector_taxonomy.generic_unit: v_q(y)=0 and y mod q is not 0,+1,-1. Under k*r*d=1, all four roots lift iff there is y0 in F_q with chi(y0)=d, chi(1-y0)=k, chi(1+y0)=r; the two extra-root residues swap because lambda^2=-1 mod q
valuation_sector_taxonomy.near_plus_or_minus_one: a local point in either residue class y=+/-1 mod q necessarily has d=1 and k=r=s. Conversely, if d=1 and k=r=s, choose y=+/-1+q^n*c with even n>2h and chi(c)=s; the source tie has even valuation and the opposite extra tie is controlled by lambda^2+1, giving all four roots
valuation_sector_taxonomy.exhaustive: every q-adic y lies in exactly one of small, large, generic-unit, near +1, near -1, so the stated sectors give a necessary and sufficient local criterion

hard_patterns_after_Q_row: k and r have opposite signs, so d=-1
finite_field_generic_existence.generic_pattern_count: for each hard pattern, the number N of y0 not in {0,+1,-1} with chi(y0)=d, chi(1-y0)=k, chi(1+y0)=r is exactly (q+1+C_q)/8
finite_field_generic_existence.consequence: every hard character pattern has a generic-unit realization; no finite-field residue pattern remains obstructed after the BU Q-row

main_consequence.statement: For a general AW squareclass branch and an odd q|Q, the BU row Legendre(mu*A*B,q)=+1 is necessary and sufficient for existence of a Q_q point on the exact BT four-square full-cover local model on the retained open.
main_consequence.sufficiency_source: 36-09CI valuation-sector construction plus the Hasse-bound generic count
